title: Form filling library on real documents
notes: Library half of the forms pair per ADR 0012 (docs/decisions/0012-feature-tasks-split-library-and-shell.md). Serves acceptance items A-25 (Fill & Sign form fields) and O-05 (fill, tab order, save with appearances, FDF/XFDF, flatten) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Loads AcroForm fields from real bytes, fills and flattens through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010, writes appearances so a saved file reopens filled, and proves it on fixtures/realworld/** read-only. A serialised app shell task follows once this lands and owns crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/**; matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
